channel: Wikimedia Commons - Chinese and other labs: Kling, Hailuo/MiniMax, ByteDance Seedance, Alibaba Wan, Tencent Hunyuan, Vidu, Zhipu CogVideoX, Pixverse, Jimeng/Dreamina, xAI Grok Imagine, Lightricks LTX, Genmo Mochi, Open-Sora. Method: Commons API category enumeration (all AI-video categories, by-year and by-model categories, category-name existence probes), about 250 file-namespace full-text queries (quoted model names, Chinese product names, generic AI-video phrases, filetype:video), per-file wikitext + extmetadata + rendered licence box read, uploader contribution lists; developer primary sources (ByteDance Seed, MiniMax, xAI, THUDM GitHub/arXiv/Hugging Face licence, Lightricks GitHub) for model/date corroboration; ffprobe, scene-cut, audio-level, frame-difference and static-overlay heuristics run in the Higgsfield sandbox. No frame was ever viewed by me; all content statements come from Commons page text, ffprobe and pixel statistics. Result: Commons holds only a handful of clips for these labs - there is NO usable Commons file for Kling (only inside a mixed-tool clip), Wan, Hunyuan, Vidu, Pixverse, Jimeng/Dreamina, Genmo Mochi or Open-Sora.
verdict_scale: clear = explicit CC0/CC-BY-type licence text written by the person who generated the clip, plus a Commons PD tag; likely = licence rests on the Commons {{PD-algorithm}} tag (US-law basis: no human authorship) and/or a derivative of a free-licensed source, with some provenance gap named in notes; unclear/no = goes to rejected.
global_licence_caveat: PD-algorithm is a Commons community tag with a US-law basis. The rendered template itself warns: 'there is a risk that AI-generated media uploaded on Commons may violate the rights of the authors of the original works' and notes that the UK and Hong Kong give computer-generated works 50 years of protection. Platform/model terms of service (Hailuo, Seedance, Grok) could not be read (JS-rendered or unreachable) and are UNCHECKED; only CogVideoX has a readable model licence (it says generated content belongs to the user).
overlap_note: Three candidates (hailuo_cyberpunk_rainy_street_2024, cogvideox_late_afternoon_swans_2024, cogvideox_painting_with_the_breeze_2024) were also found by H2 (early-tool channel). Unique to H3: hailuo_i2v_japanese_nuns_1902, seedance2_husband_coming_home, grok_imagine_gotz_von_berlichingen, ltxv2b_cybertruck_from_photos.
